Visitor customizes figure and figcaption elements

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_figcaption => fn(args) ->
        {:custom, "*" <> Map.get(args, "text", "") <> "*"}
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<article><h1>Article Title</h1><p>Introduction paragraph.</p><figure><img src=\"diagram.png\" alt=\"System architecture diagram\"><figcaption>Figure 1: System Architecture</figcaption></figure><p>Explanation of the figure.</p></article>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
